Snapmaker Orca 2.4.0  Release Notes
Snapmaker Orca 2.4.0 has been released. The main updates in this version include: highlighting for selected models,, the LOD (level-of-detail) system, automatic color selection for color-match mixing mode, High-Flow Hot End parameter support, 6 new filaments plus an expanded color library, and three major underlying dependency upgrades (OpenSSL 3.5.7 / macOS build environment / Flutter 3.41), among others. 
---
New Features
1. Added Highlight-on-Select for models to improve interaction experience
  - When a model is selected, its bounding box is displayed and its edges are highlighted in white.
[image]
  - In assembly mode, the selected model's edges are highlighted in yellow.
[image]
2. Added LOD (Level of Detail) system to improve rendering efficiency in complex scenes.
3. Added color selection in Auto Match Mode for Color Mixing Match. You can now select filament colors manually.
[image]
4. Added High-Flow Hot End parameter support for select filaments and print profiles. For more information,  refer to https://wiki.snapmaker.com/en/snapmaker_u1/hot_end_guide.
[image]
5. Added 6 new filaments, all compatible with Snapmaker U1:
don't support format
[image]
6. Expanded color options for multiple filaments:
  - Snapmaker PVA: +1 color
  - PETG Translucent: +1 color
  - Support for PLA: +1 color
  - Snapmaker PLA Rainbow: +1 color (with 5 color values)
  - PLA Basic: +2 colors
  - Snapmaker TPU: +2 colors
  - PLA Full Spectrum: +4 colors
  - Snapmaker PEBA 90A: +5 colors
  - Snapmaker PLA Glow: +5 colors
  - PLA Snapspeed: +10 colors
  - PLA Silk: +14 colors
Improvements
1. Streamlined print profile presets.
  - Presets of the same layer height but different quality levels (e.g., "Fine" and "High Quality") have been merged into "Standard" presets.

2. Improved slicing stability for large models.
3. Improved upload and printing stability for G-code files.
4. Upgraded OpenSSL library to version 3.5.7, enhancing network communication security and stability.
5. Added a default value for the "Flow Compensation Model" parameter when "Small area flow compensation" is enabled, reducing manual steps.
6. Updated the app icon and the web setup wizard / homepage logos.
Bug Fixes
1. Fixed an issue where API response content was incorrectly displayed on the page after successful GitHub login.
2. Fixed an issue on Windows where the device connection status became abnormal after the screen turned off.
3. Fixed an issue where an unexpected error dialog appeared when Orca failed to connect to the device.
4. Fixed an issue where the login prompt continued to appear after a successful third-party authorization login.
5. Fixed an issue where the system incorrectly prompted for re-login after 24 hours of continuous login.
6. Mitigated white screen issues on the Home page, Device page, and Preview page under weak network conditions on all platforms (effective only in 2.4.0 and later versions).
7. Fixed an issue where slicing progress would hang at 70% when the base pattern spacing was set to 0 and the support style was set to "Tree Hybrid."
8. Fixed an issue where model rendering failed when repeatedly importing the same G-code file.
9. Fixed an issue where layer change points were displayed incorrectly in the G-code preview.
10. Fixed an issue where color information was lost when importing multi-color G-code files generated by Orca Slicer, and where the software crashed when switching filaments in the G-code preview interface.
11. Fixed an issue where the software crashed when slicing a 3MF file that had previously enabled the "Organic" support style but had it disabled afterward.
12. Fixed an issue where the software crashed during slicing due to color data overflow when painting models.
13. Fixed an issue where the software crashed when modifying filament type or color after switching nozzles, adding new filaments, and switching back to the original nozzle.
14. Fixed an issue where Snapmaker PETG HF had no official color configuration under the 0.4 mm nozzle.
15. Fixed an issue where the old color palette was still displayed when clicking the color swatch for Snapmaker PETG HF under the 0.4 mm nozzle.
16. Fixed an issue where the software failed to launch due to missing content in the hints.ini file.
17. Fixed an issue on macOS where models opened from Snapmaker Space links were dropped.(#851 / #852)Thanks to @KuzuriAo 
18. Fixed an occasional crash when sending a print job.
19. Fixed a crash when opening the preset comparison (diff) dialog.
20. Fixed abnormal loading of embedded web pages on macOS.
21. Fixed the Home / Device pages failing to render (blank screen) on macOS.
22. Fixed calibration failures caused by mismatched configuration value types.
Upgrade Notes
We recommend upgrading the device firmware to 2.0.0 or higher before installing this version.
